editions.text:
November 7 added up to 22 species, with 20 heard, 12 seen and 10 both, across 61 feeder visits. Heard detections totaled 321, above the week's average of 246.6, while visits were the lowest of the eight days, tied with November 3 and well below the average of 189.6.

Twelve species were recorded on all seven days including this one, among them American Crow, Blue Jay, Carolina Chickadee, Northern Cardinal, Tufted Titmouse and White-throated Sparrow. Tufted Titmouse led the visits with 21 confident sightings, and the first visual of the day came 11 min before sunrise. The Eastern Bluebird returned after 15 days away, last recorded on October 23, and was heard once.

The audio source was switched many times during the day, moving between c120, pi and pi-mic (movo-dom1). No species was heard for the first time at the station, and no first confident visual record was set.
